title: Isometric Illustration — One idea, four links

scenes.title: Idea lands
scenes.purpose: Establish the low-key isometric cutaway and let the idea arrive and become a solid core.
visuals: Dark slate void with a stationary soft floor-light
Isometric slab with axis-parallel grid expands about its centre
Terracotta idea diamond drops down the vertical axis
Two terracotta core cubes extrude up through the slab top
Headline copy enters on the flat 2D layer

beats.development: Slab resolves and the diamond falls from above frame, landing at 0.67 s; kicker and headline rise in.
The landing drives the lower core cube up through the slab, then the upper cube stacks on it; subtitle and IDEA leader appear.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system.

scenes.title: System connects
scenes.purpose: Show the core growing four axis-aligned links that dock four sage modules, then light up as one connected system.
visuals: Four links extend along the ±x/±z axes
Four sage modules slide inward along those same axes and dock
Dark port windows and link tops light terracotta as the connection event
Warm additive pool blooms on the slab around the core
DATA and PEOPLE leaders draw, then their labels appear; legend and footer settle

beats.development: Links extend in a quick stagger and the modules dock along their axes with no perspective change.
Connection event: link tops and module windows turn from dim to terracotta, the warm pool blooms, DATA and PEOPLE labels arrive after their leader lines.
Fully assembled, still composition held for reading.

findings: Primary focus moves diamond → core → links/modules → lit system; each action finishes before the next primary action takes over.
Headline copy enters early on an independent cue so it gets more than 2 s of settled exposure.
All motion is complete by 2.3 s, before the 2.7 s settle requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.3–3.0 s final hold lets the viewer read the labelled, connected system.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or voice.

Source-frame refresh: cool low-key cutaway void with tonal-step slab, warm emissive accent used only as the connection event, locked orthographic camera, labels in a screen-aligned 2D layer. No source subject, branding or lettering copied.
No preview recipes were supplied in STYLE.json (tech.preview_recipes is absent); the refresh demonstrates the source-frame palette/lighting lessons.
